summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is dominated by a handful of platforms that serve distinct needs, from open-weight model discovery to production-grade inference infrastructure. Hugging Face remains the default hub for open-weight AI with over 2.2 million models and 2.2 billion downloads, while deployment-focused platforms like Replicate, Together AI, and Fireworks AI compete on cost, speed, and developer experience. Enterprises increasingly layer these platforms with cloud providers like AWS Bedrock, and local deployment via Ollama has surged among privacy-conscious developers and teams.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open-weight AI model repository and collaboration hub, hosting models, datasets, and Spaces for demos and apps. Serves as the default discovery and distribution layer for the open AI ecosystem.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repositories and limited inference; Pro plan at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; pay-per-use Inference Endpoints billed by compute hour
features: 2.2 billion total model downloads as of late 2025
Top 50 downloaded entities account for 80%+ of all downloads
Hugging Face Hub API for programmatic model discovery and download
Spaces for hosting interactive ML demos
Inference Endpoints for dedicated serverless or persistent deployments
Dataset and model versioning with Git-based workflows
Community model cards, leaderboards, and evaluations
Support for all major frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX
Private repositories and organization access controls
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source developers, and teams that need to discover, share, fine-tune, or deploy open-weight models. The go-to starting point for anyone entering the open AI ecosystem.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local model runtime and library that lets developers download and run large language models entirely on their own hardware, with no cloud dependency. Functions as a local inference server with a simple CLI and REST API.
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in the Ollama library (subset of Hugging Face GGUF-compatible models)
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs limited to local hardware
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g., ollama run llama3)
Runs models locally with full data privacy and zero egress cost
OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy app integration
Supports quantized GGUF models for consumer GPU and CPU inference
Native support for macOS Apple Silicon, Linux, and Windows
Model management with versioning and Modelfile customization
Integration with Open WebUI for a self-hosted chat interface
Active GitHub repository among the top AI repos in 2026
platforms.best_for: Privacy-conscious developers, enterprises with data residency requirements, hobbyists with capable local hardware, and teams wanting to prototype offline without API costs.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running open-source machine learning models via a simple pay-per-second API, abstracting away all GPU infrastructure management. Focused on making model deployment accessible without DevOps overhead.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second billing based on GPU type used; no upfront cost or minimum spend; free tier available for low-volume experimentation
features: Simplest API surface among deployment platforms — one API call to run any model
50,000+ models including image generation, LLMs, audio, and video
Automatic cold-start scaling with no infrastructure management
Cog open-source tool for packaging custom models into containers
Webhooks and async predictions for production pipelines
Model versioning with immutable deployment snapshots
Fine-tuning support for select models like Flux and Llama
Deployments feature for dedicated always-warm endpoints
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups that need rapid access to a wide variety of models without managing infrastructure, especially for image generation, multimodal tasks, and quick prototyping.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A cloud inference and fine-tuning platform offering OpenAI-compatible APIs for open-weight LLMs at among the lowest costs in the market. Targets developers migrating from or comparing against proprietary model APIs.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open-weight LLMs including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Gemma families
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing; among the lowest in the market for popular models (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B under $0.10 per million tokens); free $25 credit on signup; volume discounts available
features: OpenAI-compatible API for drop-in replacement of proprietary models
Qwen cumulative downloads reached 942 million by March 2026, heavily served via platforms like Together
Custom fine-tuning with LoRA on your own datasets
Batch inference for high-throughput, cost-optimized workloads
Function calling and JSON mode support
Serverless and dedicated endpoint options
Together Embeddings API for vector search use cases
High throughput optimized inference stack
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and teams building LLM-powered applications who want OpenAI API compatibility with open-weight models, and organizations exploring fine-tuning without managing GPU clusters.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform specializing in fast, low-latency serving of open-weight LLMs and multimodal models with an OpenAI-compatible API. Competes primarily on speed and reliability for production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 50+ curated production-grade models with a focus on top-tier open-weight LLMs
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive rates; free tier available; compound model and function-calling endpoints may carry premium pricing; enterprise contracts available
features: Industry-leading inference speed with custom CUDA kernels and optimized serving
OpenAI-compatible API with function calling and structured output support
FireFunction models optimized for tool use and agentic workflows
Serverless and on-demand dedicated GPU deployments
Support for mixture-of-experts models like Mixtral and DeepSeek-MoE
Fine-tuning and PEFT support with fast iteration cycles
Image generation models including Stable Diffusion variants
SLA-backed uptime for production enterprise deployments
platforms.best_for: Production engineering teams that prioritize low latency and high throughput for real-time LLM features, and companies building agentic or tool-calling systems that demand reliability at scale.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: A fully managed AWS service providing access to a curated selection of foundation models from leading AI providers via a unified API, designed for enterprise-grade security, compliance, and deep AWS ecosystem integration.
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Cohere, Stability AI, Amazon, and others
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (on-demand) or Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity at discounted rates; pricing varies significantly by model; no upfront cost for on-demand; integrated with AWS Cost Explorer
features: Single API for models from multiple providers including Claude, Llama, Mistral, and Amazon Titan
Agents for Bedrock for building fully managed agentic workflows with tool use
Knowledge Bases for RAG with native vector store integrations (OpenSearch, Aurora, etc.)
Guardrails for content filtering, PII redaction, and safety controls
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training for select models
Private model deployment within customer VPC with no data sharing with model providers
Deep integration with IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and AWS PrivateLink
Model Evaluation for automated and human-in-the-loop benchmarking
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need compliance-ready, SOC 2 and HIPAA-eligible AI infrastructure with centralized governance, audit logging, and integration with existing cloud workloads.
